leads.name: Plane tree at Agios Nektarios, Kryoneri, near Archipolis
leads.reason: Single tourism-site source (aegeanislands.gr/?p=128629) says a huge plane tree stands in front of the Agios Nektarios church, 1 km from Archipolis, said to be 2,500 years old with Paul preaching under it; local tradition, no independent source, no coordinate, no photo, no alive check. Age claim must not be repeated as fact.
